author: opencode-worker-4
text: Final round-3 state (worker-4, timebox): join_leaf reworked to canonical multicast (ff02::1a, broadcast L2, Rule 255 uncompressed via send_ipv6_uncompressed_to) — mirrors root.send_dio(multicast)'s proven shape; rpl_dispatch_rejects + 2 more now GREEN (29 passed vs 27 before). Remaining 2 failures share ONE root cause, NOT fixture drift: (1) multicast_dio_and_dis_are_received:1103 and (2) three_rpl_stacks:1685 both consume SOLICITED UNICAST-DIO responses (receive.rs:578 send_dio(source) after DIS, and root.send_dio(relay_addr)/relay.send_dio(leaf_addr) unicast targeting). Empirically: the root transmits (Extended-addr frame, first byte 240 = L2_DISPATCH_SCHC) and the relay's queue receives it, but the frame dies at wire_is_for_local (util.rs:152) — for AddrMode::Extended with an RPL-claiming SCHC payload the multicast-allowed gate (util.rs:155-156/159-165) requires dst ff02::1a, so a unicast-dst DIO is dropped as not-for-local BEFORE admission even sees it. This IS the ehcn OPEN DECISION (solicited unicast-DIO receive contract): option A (multicast-only, suppress/re-target the DIS response) or option B (bounded solicited-unicast admission + wire_is_for_local change). The tests are correctly left red pending that decision — do NOT re-pin them to RplRejected, that would bless the missing receive contract. My join_leaf rework is orthogonal and correct (join does not need solicitation).
